posts.author: JotaDe
posts.title: Tazers!
posts.html:
Well, since police don't have a Standard weapon (Glock) anymore...Why not a Tazer? Tazer's affect in the same way as KO'ing people with your baton, but this is for longuer ranges (No more than 10 meters). To prevent abuse of it, say you can only use it every X amount of time.
Still I think there wouldn't be abuse, since it would be the same as KO'ing... So, abuse=ban I supose.

We all hate that guy when we're police that just happens to run as fast as you and in the long run you cant catch up, becouse you either get run down by a car, get shot at...etc. So why not a Tazer?


Ask the person (Yelling) to stopi]

Fails to stop and keeps running.

Tazer him, then tell him if he runs again he will get arrested, so he stays with you and answers your possible questions (Why you were doing such thing...etc)

I think it would make the city safer, it doesn't kill, it just KO's from further away.

posts.html:
agreed.

i usually have 350-400 ping and hitting people with the stun stick is quite hard. i mean, the game dont lag when im watching it on the screen, but the scripts of me swining the stick must lag.

 but i hit them, the sparks fly (this is while running after the person even if right behind them) and the person is still running. when i shoot some thing though, it doesnt lag and it does kill or injure who ever i shot at.

i would not like to have to kill some one because i cant hit them with the stun stick.

i would like a gun type tazer that shoots.

but the again comes the issue of......minges...

mabye only a 30 second shoot cool down?

this is quite a good idea.

mabye it can work like the tranq sniper but in pistol form only, for 10 second KO and 30 second cool down.

i agree with this. add a poll and i will vote yes.
